facts.label: Healing potions
facts.value: Superior and Major Healing Potions are First Aid crafts learned from vendor manuals (First Aid 215 and 275). They use a Crystal Vial, Soothing Spices and Sungrass or Golden Sansam.

facts.label: New remedies
facts.value: New items include Potent Anti-Venom, poultices for diseases and tourniquets for bleeds. Poultices and tourniquets only work out of combat, and all remedies share a 1-minute cooldown.

facts.label: Powerful Anti-Venom
facts.value: Now cures poisons up to level 65. Its recipe needs Argent Dawn Honored.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: First Aid Kit at skill 20, Toxin Study at 140 (blueprint from Commander Springvale in Shadowfang Keep) and Plague Doctor's Laboratory at 300.

facts.label: Expert and Artisan
facts.value: Expert First Aid comes from a book. Artisan comes from the Triage quest, which needs level 35 and First Aid 225. The cap is 300.

facts.label: Field Medicine
facts.value: This Legacy perk shortens the Recently Bandaged debuff.

facts.label: Self-made healing potions
facts.value: Major Healing Potion still heals 1050 to 1750 on a 2-minute cooldown, and now any raider with enough First Aid skill can make it.

facts.label: Heavy Runecloth Bandage
facts.value: Still heals 2000 over 8 s. You need First Aid 225 to use it and, per Icy Veins, 290 to make it.

facts.label: First Aid Kit
facts.value: The First Aid Kit's buff matches Power Word: Fortitude and does not stack with it.
